summary: Frontend-only testing of the public /verifikasi (VerifyPublic) feature and landing-page entry points. All 6 requested scenarios passed: landing links navigate correctly, verify page loads without auth, docHash-known returns VALID with correct institution+signature, docHash-unknown returns 'Tidak Ditemukan', and PDF upload triggers response and result panel renders without crashing.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (not a bug): AuthContext calls /api/auth/me on public /verifikasi page and receives 401 (visible in console). Harmless but could be suppressed on public routes.
Status badge on VALID verdict renders as 'TERVERIFIKASI' (Indonesian translation of APPROVED). This matches design intent.
test_credentials: Used pre-supplied known-approved docHash c0c0bce00569d87a3cdcb9773cead8c5364e89224b50968f3ad960a9b6b69693 which is still valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public verify page working end-to-end: /verifikasi routes without auth guard; POST /api/verify/document (multipart with docHash or file) integrates correctly; verdict panel, signature (208 chars), institution 'Universitas Nusantara', keyIdentifier 'sahkan-key-ed493410' all render. Landing testids landing-verify-top and landing-cta-verify both navigate to /verifikasi. File upload with arbitrary PDF properly returns Not Found state.
